evaluation_ratio.caveat: normal approximation at observed point/variance; DG-only search + historical fresh acquisition price; no guarantee, no automatic top-up

reliability_margin.caveat: normal approximation at observed point/variance; DG-only search + historical fresh acquisition price; no guarantee, no automatic top-up

metric_definitions.R: ratio of arithmetic mean actual evaluations R-tree / R-A8; eight cells equally weighted, failures spend actual total cap
metric_definitions.reliability: solve-fraction difference R-tree minus R-A8; lower paired-build 95% bound > -0.03 establishes noninferiority within three percentage points
metric_definitions.bootstrap: 8192 paired resamples of 24 acquisition-build blocks; all fixed cells and repeats retained within block
metric_definitions.geometric: exp(mean(log(actual solved evaluations or two times total cap for failures))); descriptive sensitivity
metric_definitions.savings: mean(actual R-tree effort minus actual A8 effort), evaluations and worker seconds separately
metric_definitions.repayment: historical mean acquisition / contemporaneous mean search saving; interval unbounded when savings admit zero or negative values
metric_definitions.phenotype_diversity: distinct output vectors on 64 fixed training cases; lower bound on D625 phenotype diversity
metric_definitions.primitive_case_work: compiled token count times 64 cases, execution-length proxy excluding exact checks and internal primitive costs

primary: DG R-tree/R-A8 arithmetic evaluations with paired reliability guard
scope: fixed DG/TS development rosters; no transfer or optimal-policy claim
acquisition_timing: historical acquisition worker seconds plus contemporary search seconds; hardware/load limits; point-estimates are not resolved repayment
